principle: Public-event transcripts and Jamie's simultaneous documentary photography should become mutually retrievable without turning private metadata, face labels, temporal proximity, or prior selection depth into identity proof or publication permission.

criteria.description: Every event-photo return begins from a named, dated, hash-bound public-event transcript and a bounded speaking interval.
Capture time, import time, timezone, and scan-date uncertainty remain distinct.
Apple Photos People labels are used only as private retrieval signals and never as public identity proof.
Nested _keep depth is recorded as prior curatorial process evidence, while _aside and earlier-level alternatives remain recoverable.
A human inspects the pixels and confirms event context before any public-safe photo relationship is materialized.
Private Photos identifiers, faces, coordinates, and filesystem paths remain outside public Git.
Rights, consent, safety, collective credit, crop, caption, and exact destination remain separate human publication gates.
The method preserves both the earlier selection decision and the present transcript-situated rereading instead of silently replacing either.
